get.description:
:::info
[Read more about Inventory Sets](https://help.fleetio.com/s/article/Switching-to-an-Advanced-Inventory-Valuation-Method-FIFO-LIFO#inventory-sets)
:::

This endpoint provides Part price breakdown for the requested quantity at
the requested location based on the **Advanced Inventory Valuation** method. This
endpoint should not be used if the account is using standard Static Pricing.

The `added_at` value represents the date at which the inventory was added to
the location.

position.description: This Part's rank within the shared cross-reference group. Values are not contiguous once `with_cross_reference_member_locations` narrows the members returned. A group of five narrowed to two can return positions 1 and 4.

The array holds active Part Locations only, is further narrowed to `part_location_id` when one is given, and always omits Part Locations the current API credentials cannot read.

available_quantity.description: How many of this member are available at this Part Location.

reorder_point.description: The lower-threshold quantity at which this member should be reordered at this Part Location.

average_unit_cost.description: The average unit cost for this member at this Part Location.

active.description: Always `true`; this array holds active Part Locations only. Present so a consumer holding both this array and the Part's own `part_locations` array can tell them apart. `part_locations` is not filtered to active Part Locations.

track_inventory.description: Indicates whether inventory is tracked for this member at this Part Location.

cross_reference_group_id.description: The cross-reference group this Part belongs to, or `null` when it belongs to none. Unlike `cross_reference_members` this is present on index and archived responses as well, so a list can be read for which Parts have compatible Parts without a request per Part -- and two Parts sharing a value are compatible with each other. Only present when the cross-references feature is enabled for the account.

unit_cost.description: The unit cost for this Part.

unit_cost_unit.description: The measurement unit used by this Part.

available_quantity.description: The total quantity on hand for this Part at locations the current API credentials can read. It is not affected by `part_location_id`. The value stays account-wide even when the request narrows `part_location_details` to a single location, which is where per-location quantities live.

position.description: This Part's rank within the shared cross-reference group. Values are not contiguous once `with_cross_reference_member_locations` narrows the members returned. A group of five narrowed to two can return positions 1 and 4.

part_location_details.description: This member's per-location stock, sorted by Part Location name. Only present when the request opts in with `with_cross_reference_member_locations`. The array holds active Part Locations only, is further narrowed to `part_location_id` when one is given, and always omits Part Locations the current API credentials cannot read.

items.title: PartCrossReferenceMemberLocation
items.description: One Part Location's stock for a member of a Part's cross-reference group. Only present when the request opts in with `with_cross_reference_member_locations`.

part_location_name.description: The name of the Part Location for this member.

available_quantity.description: How many of this member are available at this Part Location.

reorder_point.description: The lower-threshold quantity at which this member should be reordered at this Part Location.

average_unit_cost.description: The average unit cost for this member at this Part Location.

active.description: Always `true`; this array holds active Part Locations only. Present so a consumer holding both this array and the Part's own `part_locations` array can tell them apart. `part_locations` is not filtered to active Part Locations.

track_inventory.description: Indicates whether inventory is tracked for this member at this Part Location.

cross_reference_group_id.description: The cross-reference group this Part belongs to, or `null` when it belongs to none. Unlike `cross_reference_members` this is present on index and archived responses as well, so a list can be read for which Parts have compatible Parts without a request per Part -- and two Parts sharing a value are compatible with each other. Only present when the cross-references feature is enabled for the account.

In the Fleetio UI, this top-level configuration may be labeled as a "subscription".
In this API, the top-level resource is a Repair Order Notification Policy.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id of the relevant record

schema.title: Repair Order Notification Policy
schema.description:
A full representation of a Repair Order Notification Policy.

In the Fleetio UI, the overall configuration may be labeled as a "subscription".
In this API, this schema represents the top-level policy configuration.

Nested `subscriptions` are recipient-level records. Each one represents one
recipient and that recipient's notification settings for this policy.

notification_frequency_in_minutes.description: Notification frequency in minutes. A null value indicates the policy is using the default notification schedule.

subscriptions.description: Recipient-level notification records for this policy. Each item represents one subscribed recipient and that recipient's notification settings.

patch.description:
Updates an existing Repair Order Notification Policy on your account.
This endpoint updates the top-level policy configuration, even if the Fleetio
UI refers to that configuration more broadly as a "subscription".
Groups are updated by replacing the full `group_ids` set. Send the complete desired set of Group ids, or an empty array to remove all Groups.
Subscription recipients are specified by `contact_id`.
Contacts can only be added as recipients if they belong to the current account and have an associated User.
Existing subscription settings can be updated by `id` alone without sending
`contact_id` when the recipient is not changing.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id of the relevant record

group_ids.description:
Replaces the full set of Groups on the policy.
Provide the complete set of desired Group ids.
Use an empty array to remove all Groups.

subscriptions.description:
Subscription updates for this policy.
Existing subscription settings can be updated by `id` alone when the recipient is not changing.

id.title: Id
id.description:
The existing subscription id.
Use this to update an existing subscription's settings without changing the recipient.

_destroy.description:
Set to `true` to remove an existing subscription.
When removing a subscription, provide exactly one of `id` or `contact_id` to identify the existing subscription.

contact_id.title: Id
contact_id.description:
The Contact to associate to this subscription.
The Contact must belong to the current account and have an associated User.
This is required when creating a new subscription, can be used when reassigning an existing subscription's recipient, and can also be used to identify an existing subscription when removing it.

patch.description:
Updates an existing Motor Pool Reservation. The fields accepted depend on
the reservation's current `status`:
  - `requested`: `motor_pool_id`, `vehicle_type_ids`, `reason_for_trip`,
    `pick_up_at`, `drop_off_at`, `custom_fields`.
  - `approved`: `reason_for_trip`, `vehicle_id`, `pick_up_at`, `drop_off_at`,
    `custom_fields`, `motor_pool_reservation_line_items_attributes`,
    `vehicle_assignment`.
  - `checked_out`, `returned`, or `completed`: the same fields as `approved`,
    except `vehicle_id` can no longer be changed.

  Fields outside the current status's set are silently ignored rather than
  raising an error. `denied` and `canceled` reservations cannot be updated
  at all.

get.description: Retrieve the details of an existing Acquisition.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id of the relevant record

acquisition_type.title: AcquisitionType
acquisition_type.description: The acquisition type of the asset.

first_payment_date.description: The date of the first payment for the `Acquisition`, if applicable.

number_of_payments.description:
For `lease` type Acquisitions, this number represents the number of
months for which the vehicle is leased. For `loan` type Acquisitions,
this number represents the number of payments until the loan is paid
off.

mileage_cap.description:
For `lease` type Acquisitions, this number represents the number of
miles allowed each year, before additional charges will be incurred.

annual_percentage_rate.description: For `loan` type Acquisitions, the annual percentage rate for the loan.

reference_number.description:
Optional data for collecting information such as the invoice number,
transaction id, or receipt number.

notes.description: Optional free text field for additional notes.

loan_amount.description:
For `loan` type Acquisitions, the total principal amount at the start
of the loan.

down_payment_amount.description: For `loan` type Acquisitions, the amount of the initial down payment.

monthly_cost.description: Total amount that will be paid each month including any taxes and fees.

capitalized_cost.description: Capitalized cost per month of the `Vehicle`.

residual_value.description:
For `lease` type Acquisitions, the value of the `Vehicle` at the end of
the lease.

purchase_price.description: For `loan` type Acquisitions, the total purchase price of the `Vehicle`.

mileage_charge.description:
For `lease` type Acquisitions, the amount charged for each mile over
the mileage cap.

acquisition_date.description: The date on which the Acquisition occurred or began.

acquisition_end_date.description: The date on which the Acquisition ends or is scheduled to end.

parameters.name: start_cursor
parameters.description: The start cursor for Keyset pagination.

parameters.name: per_page

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: The fields, operations, and values to filter the records by.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The fields and direction to sort the results by.

start_cursor.description: The current start cursor of the records returned.

next_cursor.description: The next cursor to retrieve the next page of records.

per_page.description: The maxumum number of records returned.

estimated_remaining_count.description: The number of remaining records including the returned records, up to a maximum of 500.

sorted_by.description: The sorts applied to the returned record set.

external_id.description:
Used to uniquely identify Fuel Entries that are imported from external
systems, such as Fleetcor and Wex.

fuel_type_id.description: The Fleetio `id` of the `Fuel Type` associated with this Fuel Entry.

vehicle_id.description: The Fleetio `id` of the [Vehicle](/docs/api/vehicles) associated with this Fuel Entry.

vendor_id.description: The Fleetio `id` of the [Vendor](/docs/api/vendors) associated with this Fuel Entry.

partial.description:
Used to denote a partial fuel up as opposed to a complete fuel up. Learn
more about partial Fuel Entries
[here](https://help.fleetio.com/s/article/Partial-Fuel-Entries).

personal.description: Used to denote a personal expense.

reference.description:
Optional data field for collecting information such as the invoice number,
transaction id, or receipt number, for example.

images_count.description: The count of Images associated with this Fuel Entry.

documents_count.description: The count of Documents associated with this Fuel Entry.

comments_count.description: The count of Comments associated with this Fuel Entry.

watchers_count.description: The count of Watchers associated with this Fuel Entry.

date.description: The date and time at which this Fuel Entry was recorded.

created_at.description: The date and time this Fuel Entry was created.

updated_at.description: The date and time this Fuel Entry was last updated.

cost_per_hr.description: The automatically calculated cost per hour since the last Fuel Entry.

cost_per_km.description: The automatically calculated cost per km since the last Fuel Entry.

cost_per_mi.description: The automatically calculated cost per mi since the last Fuel Entry.

kpl.description: Running average recorded kilometers per liter (calculated automatically).

uk_gallons.description:
The fuel volume amount in UK gallons. This field will _only_ be used if
the [Vehicle](/docs/api/vehicles) is [configured to use UK
Gallons](https://help.fleetio.com/s/article/Fuel-Settings#vehicle-settings),
otherwise it will be ignored.

uk_gallons_per_hr.description: Running average of UK gallons used per hour. Calculated automatically.

us_gallons.description:
The fuel volume amount in US gallons. This field will _only_ be used if
the [Vehicle](/docs/api/vehicles) is [configured to use US
Gallons](https://help.fleetio.com/s/article/Fuel-Settings#vehicle-settings),
otherwise it will be ignored.

us_gallons_per_hr.description: Running average of US gallons used per hour. Calculated automatically.

liters.description:
The fuel volume amount in liters. This field will _only_ be used if the
[Vehicle](/docs/api/vehicles) is [configured to use
liters](https://help.fleetio.com/s/article/Fuel-Settings#vehicle-settings),
otherwise it will be ignored.

liters_per_hr.description: Running average recorded liters per hour (calculated automatically).

lp100k.description:
Running average recorded liters per 100 kilometers (calculated
automatically).

mpg_uk.description: Running average recorded miles per UK Gallon (calculated automatically).

mpg_us.description: Running average recorded miles per US Gallon (calculated automatically).

price_per_volume_unit.description: The unit price for the `Vehicle`'s volume unit.

usage_in_hr.description:
The automatically calculated usage in hours since the most recent Fuel
Entry.

usage_in_km.description:
The automatically calculated usage in kilometers since the most recent
Fuel Entry.

usage_in_mi.description:
The automatically calculated usage in miles since the most recent
Fuel Entry.

total_amount_cents.description: The total amount of the Fuel Entry in cents.

read_photos.description: Indicates whether the user has read permission for photos.

manage_photos.description: Indicates whether the user has permission to manage (eg. upload, delete) photos.

read_documents.description: Indicates whether the user has read permission for documents.

manage_documents.description: Indicates whether the user has permission to manage (eg. upload, delete) documents.

The date on which this Warranty's coverage ends.

The primary meter reading at which this Warranty's coverage begins.
A start reading on either the primary or the secondary meter is required.

end_primary_meter.description:
The primary meter reading at which this Warranty's coverage ends.

start_secondary_meter.description:
The secondary meter reading at which this Warranty's coverage begins.
A start reading on either the primary or the secondary meter is required.

end_secondary_meter.description:
The secondary meter reading at which this Warranty's coverage ends.
Accepted as given, not derived from `start_secondary_meter` and the term duration.

primary_meter_unlimited.description: Indicates whether this Warranty's primary meter coverage is unlimited.

secondary_meter_distance.description:
The number of secondary meter units this Warranty covers.

a given API key or Organization, such as the company name and address.

meter_entry_attributes.description:
A Service Entry may be associated with a [Meter
Entry](/docs/api/meter-entries)

value.description: The value is the actual number on the meter that increments over time.  The unit is determined by the [configured `meter_unit`](https://help.fleetio.com/s/article/Fuel-Settings#vehicle-settings) on the associated Vehicle.

void.description: If you attempt to save a meter value, which is too high or too low, Fleetio's validation rules will reject it. If you need to bypass this validation, you may [mark an entry as void](https://help.fleetio.com/s/article/Meter-Entry-Mark-As-Void-Unmark-As-Void).

secondary_meter_entry_attributes.description:
A Service Entry may also be associated with a secondary [Meter
Entry](/docs/api/meter-entries)

parameters.name: with_cross_reference_member_locations
parameters.description:
Whether each entry in `cross_reference_members` carries its per-Part-Location stock in
`part_location_details`, and whether the list is narrowed to the members holding stock.
Omitting this parameter returns the same body as passing `false`.

parameters.name: part_location_id[]
parameters.description:
Which Part Locations to read, when `with_cross_reference_member_locations` is `true`.
A member is returned only if it holds stock at one of these Part Locations, and it carries
those Part Locations alone in `part_location_details`. Omit to read every Part Location the
current API credentials can see. Repeat the parameter for more than one -
`part_location_id[]=1&part_location_id[]=2` - or pass a single id without the brackets.
Values that are not positive integers are ignored, so a comma-separated list reads as no
filter at all rather than as several Part Locations.

schema.title: Repair Order Notification Policy

A full representation of a Repair Order Notification Policy.

In the Fleetio UI, the overall configuration may be labeled as a "subscription".
In this API, this schema represents the top-level policy configuration.

Nested `subscriptions` are recipient-level records. Each one represents one
recipient and that recipient's notification settings for this policy.

subscriptions.description: Recipient-level notification records for this policy. Each item represents one subscribed recipient and that recipient's notification settings.

number.description: The part number being used for this Part within Fleetio.

unit_cost.description: The unit cost for this Part.

unit_cost_unit.description: The measurement unit used by this Part.

available_quantity.description: The total quantity on hand for this Part at locations the current API credentials can read. It is not affected by `part_location_id`. The value stays account-wide even when the request narrows `part_location_details` to a single location, which is where per-location quantities live.

position.description: This Part's rank within the shared cross-reference group. Values are not contiguous once `with_cross_reference_member_locations` narrows the members returned. A group of five narrowed to two can return positions 1 and 4.

part_location_details.description: This member's per-location stock, sorted by Part Location name. Only present when the request opts in with `with_cross_reference_member_locations`. The array holds active Part Locations only, is further narrowed to `part_location_id` when one is given, and always omits Part Locations the current API credentials cannot read.

items.title: PartCrossReferenceMemberLocation
items.description: One Part Location's stock for a member of a Part's cross-reference group. Only present when the request opts in with `with_cross_reference_member_locations`.

part_location_name.description: The name of the Part Location for this member.

available_quantity.description: How many of this member are available at this Part Location.

reorder_point.description: The lower-threshold quantity at which this member should be reordered at this Part Location.

average_unit_cost.description: The average unit cost for this member at this Part Location.

active.description: Always `true`; this array holds active Part Locations only. Present so a consumer holding both this array and the Part's own `part_locations` array can tell them apart. `part_locations` is not filtered to active Part Locations.

track_inventory.description: Indicates whether inventory is tracked for this member at this Part Location.

cross_reference_group_id.description: The cross-reference group this Part belongs to, or `null` when it belongs to none. Unlike `cross_reference_members` this is present on index and archived responses as well, so a list can be read for which Parts have compatible Parts without a request per Part -- and two Parts sharing a value are compatible with each other. Only present when the cross-references feature is enabled for the account.
